notes.title: Update: Lava Falls
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/lavafalls_header2.png[/img]

Nestled in the Haunted Island’s steep mountain range, lurk the fabled [b][i]Lava Falls[/i][/b]. Cascading rivers of magma swiftly descend at extremely high altitude. 

Do you have the guts and stamina to withstand the heat, and beat the creeps? 

[i]Happy Tuesday[/i] showcased Lava Falls to an enthusiastic crowd at the gamescom. Now it’s time to bring the lava home and melt some corpses, together.

[img]http://www.happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/lavafalls_photo6thumb.png[/img]      [img]http://www.happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/lavafalls_photo2thumb.png[/img]

Unlike other maps, Lava Falls is [b]asymmetrical[/b], forcing you and your friends to experiment with a variety of gameplay styles. More challenging than previous experiences, it features a warm blend of summer colors and is our [b]toughest Co-op map[/b] yet.

Enjoy playing Lava Falls and the array of improvements coming your way, today. Playing with the [b]Steam Controller[/b] is easier and more fun, and you can now cycle through your Heroes with [b]Tab[/b] or [b]Caps Lock[/b].

Wishing you all a scorching end to the summer!
/Happy Tuesday

P.S. As always, you can find the [b][url=http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html]Patch Notes[/url][/b] in the usual place.

notes.title: Update 1.2.4
notes.notes:
[img]http://happy-tuesday.de/HauntedIsland/img/update-1.2.4.png[/img]

Happy Tuesday, everyone!

We’ve prepared another update for you guys today with improvements for multiplayer. Here’s an overview of the main changes:

Another quick reminder: if you haven’t yet left a [b]HERO DEFENSE[/b] review on Steam, we would really appreciate it if you could take a few moments to share your experiences!

More details on our plans for gamescom, Co-op and multiplayer will be announced shortly.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - Co-Op Mode released!
notes.notes:
[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/SV_CoOp_Skullriver_026.png[/img]

We have released the first version of the new [b]Co-Op[/b] mode! You can now get together with a friend and try to beat as many waves as possible on the new SKULLRIVER map. 
Jump right in and let us know how far you got and how you like it! 

[h1]Tactical Pause[/h1]
One long awaited feature has finally arrived! You can now [i]pause[/i] the game to give you some breathing room and reposition your heroes. 
The standard hotkey for this is Left Ctrl and of course it only works in Singleplayer. 

[h1]Golddrop cooldown[/h1]
There is now a short cooldown on dropped gold in PvP before it can be collected by the enemy. With this, we want to give you a chance to see the gold before it drops - however, the time frame is small, so you still have to be quick. 
Also - if you manage to kill the last creep in an enemy wave, the gold will belong to you. 

You can view the complete patchnotes [url=http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html]HERE[/url]

If you want to see some Dev on Dev co-op action, join in to our Devstream on Friday, 6pm CET - Follow our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/herodefense]TWITCH CHANNEL[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 & Co-op
notes.notes:
HAPPY TUESDAY! Many of you will be very happy to hear that we are currently working on a [b]Co-op mode[/b] for Hero Defense, except something on this front soon! 
For now - here's a teaser on the new Co-op map:
[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/Skullriver_Small.gif[/img]

We are also releasing Patch 1.0.1 today, bringing in some changes. 

[b]IMPORTANT NOTICE - Due to a server issue, players from germany might have trouble downloading the newest patch, changing the "Download Region" of Steam to the U.S will fix this[/b]

[h1]Pure skill competitive multi player[/h1]
We are changing the way a multi player season works - from now on, you will start with an already big pool of runes and skill points, but will not get any more with more matches. 
This means that you will no longer be pummelled by players who just played more than you did, it all comes down to your skill, rune builds and heroes. 
Creeps on multi player maps will still drop gold - this can be used to buy spells directly on the map. 

Additionally, we are introducing the [b]Hall of Fame[/b] - with each season you participated in, you receive Fame, increasing your rank on this leader board. 

[h1]Cheater general amnesty[/h1]
With the new pure skill system, we are doing a general amnesty for every cheater that has been banned so far. If these individuals (you know who you are) are detected again as cheaters, it will result in a life-long ban from Hero Defense. 

[h1]Zoom[/h1]
Use the [i]mouse wheel[/i] to zoom to get a better overview of the map and see everything! 

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
We also did a bunch of bugfixes - we've fixed the tooltips being offset, some issues in the intro sequence, and we also added the missing translations of [b]Italian[/b] and [b]Portuguese[/b]

As always, you can find the full Release notes [url=http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html]HERE[/url]

notes.title: FULL RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/Release.png[/img]

[b]IT'S A VERY HAPPY TUESDAY![/b]
Hero Defense is now out of the Early Access program and officially released.
Again we want to say thanks to our community - thank you for your time, your feedback and your love!

Today's patch not only marks our transition from Early Access to full release, it also gives you a super big update with lots of amazing things!

[h1]Overhauled Tutorial Experience[/h1]
After a lot of feedback, user testing and your input, we went ahead and completely overhauled the tutorial experience. The new tutorial is more story driven and provides you with much more excitement when entering Haunted Island for the first time. 
Even if you already know how the game works, the new tutorial is definitely worth checking out. 

[h1]Improved Multiplayer GUI[/h1]
We've added the "OPPONENT VIEWER" to the multiplayer mode, perfectly showing you your enemies' weaknesses to exploit. 
Additionally, we've added better feedback to show why you won or lost a game. 

[h1]More Features![/h1]
There's a ton of small stuff being added to the game as well - more music, more languages, [b]multiplayer achievements[/b], more endless mode maps, etc, etc. 

And because that is not enough, we've been very busy with obliterating every bug we could find on the island. For a complete list, see our [url=http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html]PATCH NOTES[/url].

notes.title: Patch 0.3.2 - EPIC LEAGUE, Cheat Detection and more
notes.notes:
[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/CheatProtection.png[/img]

Another Happy Tuesday means another Hero Defense patch! 

[h1]Season System[/h1]
We've finished the season system. This allows us to do special events and more. To celebrate this - we will do the EPIC LEAGUE OF SLAYERS tournament, tomorrow, Wednesday, from 4pm to 10pm CET. The event will feature a lot of endgame content, and all epic runes! 
The winner will get  5 Hero Defense keys to give his friends! 

[h1]Cheat Detection[/h1]
We've improved our algorithms for detecting and banning cheaters. Henceforth, if a player is suspected of cheating, he will be suspended or banned from multiplayer. 

[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/HeroDefense_Screenshot_ManorEndless.jpg[/img]

Of course, endless mode is still developed as well - a new endless map is released - re-live your fight against Count Necrosis in an endless nightmare - the CASTLE endless map is out! 
Furthermore, we've improved the difficulty ramp up of all endless maps, which should give everybody a good shot at defeating at least a few waves!

As always, you can find the detailed patch notes [url=http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html]HERE[/url]

The patch also begins a new ranked season. Congratulations to the Top10 of the last one!

[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/SeasonResultsTop10.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.2.3 - Endless Mode done!
notes.notes:
[img] http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/EndlessModeDone.png[/img]
This weeks patch sees the feature completion of the Endless mode - with the new [b]HALL OF SLAYERS.[/b] For this, we want to give you a summary of how everything in the Endless Mode work. 

[h1]Challenge Cycle[/h1]
Every Endless challenge cycle will run for 1 Week. A challenge cycle has three maps with a waveset that is the same for everybody. In the next weeks, we will add more and more maps, until all of the maps currently in the game are present as an Endless Map version. 
At the end of the cycle, everybody will gain [b]Rewards[/b] based on their Leaderboard rank. 

[h1]Leaderboard[/h1]
The goal of the endless mode is to come as far as possible, the more waves re defeated the higher your rank in the Leaderboard will be. 

[h1]Hall of Slayer[/h1]
Participating in the endless mode does not only give you resources like gold and gems, but also increases your [b]Slayer Score[/b] placing you higher and higher in the Hall of Slayers, where only the mightiest vampire hunters reside. 


[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
In addition to that, we've added a new Endless Map - THE TOWER ! 
[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/HeroDefense_Screenshot_TowerEndless.jpg[/img]
Several [b]Visual Fx[/b] have been improved and fixed as well, this should result in better performance as well as better readability. 

Also - congratulations to the Top10 from the last challenge Cycle - holy crap, [b]Vexon[/b] is on fire - somebody - beat him!
[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/Leaderboards_Results_26_04_2016[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.1a released
notes.notes:
We've released the Hotfix 0.2.1a - this fixes 2 major issues found by community members: 

[b]Fixed Decrease Charge Runes[/b]
Now, decrease charge runes work much better together - 2 epic runes will be more effective than 1 epic and one rare, like it is expected. 
Additionally, we've fixed an issue that caused multiple Decrease Charge Runes to actually increae the charge costs at some point. 

[b]Fixed Orb Overflow Glitch[/b]
We fixed an issue that caused a possible overflow of Chargecosts, causing them to go negative, enabling unlimited charging. 

Big thanks to [i]Ryan is not amused[/i] for finding these issues!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7 released - Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
Today's patch sees some Bugfixes and usability improvements. 

[h1]Levelselect Improvements[/h1]
A lot of players have given us feedback on the Levelselect, and we are slowly starting to implement some of it. 
Difficulties can now be set directly instead of cycling through all of them. Additionally, you can now see the Rune that you will
gain upon completion, giving you a very good basis of deciding which map to play next. 

[h1]Rune Merging[/h1]
Some players have noticed that merging Legendary runes results in common Runes - that is fixed now. 
Also - there are awesome effects now when merging runes, that make it even cooler. 

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
We have toiled away on bugfixes again, fixing some minor interface issues, as well as some bigger ones. 
The biggest of which was an issue that caused Waves to not enter the map after their countdown ran out. If you've found the higher difficulties
too easy, that is why - so buckle up and go at it again to see if you still have it! 

[img]http://happy-tuesday.com/HauntedIsland/img/Levelselect_0.1.7.PNG[/img]

As always, you can find the detailled patchnotes [url=http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html]here[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.1.5 - RUNE MERGE!
notes.notes:
Today, we release the patch 0.1.5 - with a new Feature - [b]RUNE MERGE[/b]

[img]https://scontent-fra3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xfl1/v/t1.0-9/12813918_10206158454456908_6568420693254805236_n.jpg?oh=b7e0446e81bb1b182ef77d1b0d95e99d&oe=5758E8F5[/img]

[h1]Rune Merge[/h1]
You can now merge Runes in the Forge - the perfect tool to get rid of all those weak common runes lying around everyhwere. 
Here's how it works: Click the new [i]Merge[/i] Button in the Forge, drag Runes into the slots (4 common, 6 uncommon or 8 rares) , and click MERGE. 
You will recieve the same rune of the higher tier if all Runes were the same or a random one from the higher tier if they were different. 


[h1]Rune Tooltips[/h1]
No more wondering what the next Charge level will bring - hover over the Runes above your heroes to see their effects at a glimpse. 


[h1]Endboss Story Sequences[/h1]
**Minor Spoiler ahead** Some of you have been asking about the conclusion to some of the story elements - some of them happen in the Boss sequences during the first time you play Manor - we made sure that you see all of them across multiple plays - so it's worth to check it out again!

As always - you can find the detailed patchnotes [url=http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html]here[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.1.3 - Stronger Wylde, Diverse Late Game, Border Scrolling
notes.notes:
Fellow Slayers!

We keep reading your feedback and watching you play on YouTube and Twitch. This is what we changed this week:

[h1]Stronger Wylde[/h1]
Wylde is a lot stronger now, especially in the early game. We raised both his base damage and his damage bonus against Werewolves. Now he cuts through those Werewolf waves like a hot knife through butter! 

[h1]Diverse Late Game[/h1]
We changed our game mechanics to make shrines and auras dramatically more efficient in the late game. This should open up a whole lot of new build options, reward careful placement of shrines and positioning of characters and diversify the roles of the different heroes. We're excited to see how this changes your playstyle!

[h1]Border Scrolling[/h1]
We added border scrolling and arrow key camera movement. Please tell us what you think about it. Is the movement speed ok, or do you want it faster or slower?

[h1]Map Balancing[/h1]
We also continued working on the singleplayer campaign. We increased the number of spells available on Hard and Insane difficulty. And we keep making sure that maps don't constantly switch between paths to allow more strategic gameplay.

[h1]Skip Victory Screen[/h1]
And last, but not least, by popular request, you can now finally skip the victory screen animations!

We also fixed a couple of smaller bugs and inconsistencies. You can read the full patch notes here: http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html

If you are interested in a detailed explanation of the aura / shrine mechanics changes, check out our [url=http://forum.hero-defense.com/viewtopic.php?f=3&t=150]Beta Forum[/url].

Keep sending us your feedback, so we can make the game better!

    Your Hero Defense Team

Fellow Slayers!

First of all: Thank you all for your incredible support! Watching you guys playing the game has helped us a lot in finding the weak spots, especially during the campaign. Therefore the focus for this week’s patch is the implementation of [b]mouse-over tooltips[/b] and [b]campaign balancing[/b].

In addition to that we have implemented beautiful art for Steam Achievements!

Another focus was to address [b]character/gameplay balancing[/b]:
We see that most people are actively running around with all five characters. This can get a bit laborious and is not intended gameplay. You should move to win, but you should be able to concentrate on the important characters per wave/creep. That’s why we reworked Jane’s basic stats to make her the “Igor-Slaying Machine” she is intended to be.

Thank you
 Hero Defense Team

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 - Fixes Savegame Bug
notes.notes:
We just uploaded version 0.1.1. While we are still working hard to get the multiplayer ready for you, we fixed the most critical bugs and issues that popped up in the last week: 

The biggest issue by far was that some players lost their savegames when attaching devices to their computer. The good news is that [b]no savegames are actually lost[/b], the game just accidentally created a new save slot. When you start the game for the first time after downloading the patch, it will automatically scan for other savegames and pick the one where you have the most progress. 
Fixing this also allowed us to finally enable [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b].

We also fixed some [b]major exploits[/b] in the rune system:
Using multiple [b]Charge Cost Reduction[/b] runes now gives [b]diminishing returns[/b]. This ensures that you can no longer reduce the charge cost of a character to zero.

The second major exploit was with the [b]Orbs on Hit[/b] and [b]Gold on Hit[/b] runes. When added to a character with a very high attack speed and multiple projectiles (i.e. Wylde), they were able to generate ridiculous amounts of orbs and gold. We now added a short [b]cooldown timer[/b] to those runes. They can only trigger once every 0.5 seconds per character. They should still be pretty strong, and be the gold farming mechanic they were designed to be, but they shouldn't be as ridiculously broken as before.

The [b]Master Blacksmith achievement[/b] is fixed now. If you have already upgraded all weapons to the max level, you will be granted the achievement once you start a map.

From watching some of the YouTubers and Twitch streamers play, we realized that [b]selecting characters[/b] by clicking on them or their portraits didn't work reliably. This should be fixed now - please tell us if works for you now.

We also made a couple of other minor fixes and quality of life improvements.
You can find the full patch notes here: [url=http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html]http://hero-defense.com/PatchNotes.html [/url]
